# Button intent props

Source: `src/core/buttonIntent.tsx` and each control's exported props.

| Component | Prop | Values | Availability |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Button | `intent` | `commit`, `alternative`, `dismiss`, `neutral`, `destructive` | Optional |
| Button | `step` | `entry`, `confirm` | Only with `intent="destructive"` |
| IconButton | `intent` | `commit`, `alternative`, `dismiss`, `neutral`, `destructive` | Optional |
| IconButton | `step` | `entry`, `confirm` | Only with `intent="destructive"` |

Both controls retain `variant` for Grammar internals and stories:
`primary`, `secondary`, `tertiary`, `outline`, `ghost`, `danger`, `danger-soft`.
